info.name: Chicken Afgani Tikka
info.description: Crispy, tender and juicy chicken tikka cooked in a rich blend of aromatic spices, cooked to perfection in a clay oven.

info.name: Chicken Malai Tikka
info.description: Malai tikka at aligarh house lives up to its promise of smoky tandoori flavour beneath a layer of buttery sauce. This vintage item on our menu is highly sought after by both the elderly and kids alike.

info.name: Chicken Tikka
info.description: Tender pieces of chicken marinated in a rich blend of spices and cooked in the tandoor.

info.name: Classic Chicken Tangri
info.description: A traditional tandoori chicken dish with a twist. Tangdi is a small, succulent chicken kabab that is marinated in aromatic spices and cooked

info.name: Paneer Afgani Tikka
info.description: Paneer cubes are enveloped in an exotic blend of Afghan spices, grilled to perfection, and served with a tantalizing array of accompaniments, evoking the flavors of the silk road.

info.name: Paneer Malai Tikka
info.description: Tender cubes of paneer luxuriate in a velvety marinade crafted from creamy yogurt, fragrant spices and subtle hints of saffron, offering a melt in your mouth experience.

info.name: Paneer Tikka
info.description: Succulent cubes of paneer, delicately marinated in a symphony of aromatic spices, then charred to perfection, delivering an exquisite smoky aroma and flavor.

info.name: Special Chicken Seekh Kabab
info.description: A succulent and juicy seekh kabab made with a blend of chicken and aromatic spices. A must-try for all chicken lovers.

info.name: Aligarh House Special Tandoori Butter Chicken
info.description: Now, this uniquely white/creamy coloured butter chicken is a crowd favourite, with chicken enthusiasts buzzing about Aslam's butter chicken. The truth is, folks, it's a classic smoky tandoori chicken seasoned with a special blend of powdered spices and topped with melted butter and cream.

info.name: Tandoori Chicken
info.description: Marinated in a traditional blend of spices and cooked in a clay oven, our tandoori chicken is a juicy and flavorful dish.

info.name: Dal Makhani
info.description: Creamy black lentils, slow cooked with butter, cream and a fragrant blend of spices, resulting in a luxurious dish that evokes warmth and comfort, a quintessential indulgence for discerning palates.

info.name: Aligarh House Classic Butter Chicken
info.description: Classic butter chicken is the pride of every Punjabi for a reason. Tandoor grilled, smoky flavored chicken pieces in tomato curry should neither make it too sweet nor should the spices weigh heavily on the tongue. Every butter chicken lover knows that it is an art to maintain the balance between the two extremes. We've struck it just right at Aligarh house.

info.name: Aligarh House Special Chicken Changezi
info.description: Changezi chicken at aligarh house is a delightful surprise. Often met with suspicion about its original taste, we've delved into the roots of this dish to craft it authentically. It has become one of the most sought-after items on our menu.

info.name: Chicken Keema Khar'ra Masala
info.description: Good 'qeema' for every connoisseur has to be minced just right neither 'too thick' nor 'too pasty'. We've gone a step ahead! We decided to use whole spices instead of powdered ones to infuse just the right taste into the minced chicken pieces. Go ahead and give it a try.

info.name: Classic Mutton Paya
info.description: Delicate mutton trotters, slow cooked to perfection in a rich and aromatic gravy, infused with royal spices and garnished with silver leaf, offering a culinary experience fit for nobility.

info.name: Kadhai Paneer
info.description: Paneer cubes, sauteed with an ensemble of bell peppers, onion and aromatic spices, simmered to perfection in a robust tomato based gravy, offering a colorful and tantalizing culinary experience.

info.name: Special Butter Paneer Masala
info.description: Soft paneer cubes, gently simmered in a luscious tomato based gravy, enriched with creamy butter and aromatic spices, offering a symphony of flavours and textures that excites the palate.

info.name: Aligarh House Special Chicken Shaadi Qorma
info.description: Been to weddings in UP or Delhi? Then you know the reason behind the longest lines next to the gravy/curry counter. It's the timeless and classic 'chicken shaadi korma.' Not for the faint hearted, the layer of oil or 'rogan' on top is a must.

info.name: Special Paneer Biryani
info.description: Set aside the pulao versus biryani debate. When it's crafted at Aligarh House, with Paneer marinated in exotic spices and cooked in the traditional dum cooking method, it's undeniably biryani. Veg, this one is your pride.

info.name: Special Veg Biryani
info.description: Repeating! Forget the pulao versus biryani debate and try the veg biryani at Aligarh House. Vegetables marinated in aromatic spices, cooked in layers of long-grain basmati rice, in a 'degh' in the traditional dum style make it a special biryani. Period! Just go for it.

info.name: Aligarh House Special Khameeri Roti
info.description: Not your ordinary tandoori roti. Meet our tandoori dunlop bread popularly known as khameeri roti, generously buttered and simply divine. Pair it with our delicious gravies for a match made in heaven. Warning: you might devour it all before even touching your gravy.

info.name: Butter Naan
info.description: Fluffy, leavened, buttery and fresh from tandoor just like the way butter naan ought to be be. Pair them with our heavenly gravy dishes and each bite will bring back that unforgettable finger licking experience, every single time.

info.name: Classic Rumali Roti
info.description: Your rumali roti got to be thin and delicate and that is what we ensure when we bake them on 'ulta tawa inverted griddle. A perfect partner to our mouth watering curries divine, delicious and timeless.

info.name: Vintage Aligarh House Gulathi Sweet
info.description: For a truly authentic vintage Gulathi experience, two things are non negotiable Its thickness should come from slow cooking, not from any artificial thickening agents. It should not rely solely on grated rice or it would simply be kheer. We wager you haven't savoured such a traditional Gulathi anywhere else in Bangalore.
